about: The final test set: written on 2026-11-21, after the 0.2.0 code was frozen, and before any model answered them. Its tools (get_bookshop, get_car_rental, get_concert, get_bus_route, get_museum, get_phone_plan, get_course, get_press_release) were new then. Run rule, fixed before the runs: each command is run once; if any question ends in an error, the same command is run once more, and what is still an error counts as no answer. Times, quotes, summaries and yes/no answers are judged by hand (no values listed). Same format as questions.json.
